health.title: System health
health.intro: The state of each service this store uses. Only names and states are shown, never configuration values.

reasons.database_connected: Connected to a replica set. Transactions are available.
reasons.database_not_configured: MONGODB_URI is not set. The store shows the setup page until it is.
reasons.database_not_replica_set: Reachable, but not a replica set. Orders need transactions, so database writes are refused.
reasons.database_unreachable: Configured, but the server cannot reach it. Check the connection string and the database's network access list.
reasons.cache_not_configured: Not set. Sign-in, checkout and forms refuse requests in production until it is.
reasons.cache_memory_fallback: Not set. This development server limits requests per process instead, which is not shared between instances.
reasons.cache_unreachable: Configured, but the server cannot reach it. Limited requests are refused.
reasons.configured_not_checked: Configured. A live check is added when the feature that uses it is built.
reasons.optional_not_configured: Optional and not set. The features that use it stay hidden.
reasons.incomplete: Partly set. Every listed variable is needed.
reasons.jobs_trigger_not_set: JOBS_TRIGGER is not set, so nothing drains the outbox.
reasons.jobs_database_unavailable: The trigger is set. Outbox numbers need the database.
reasons.jobs_never_drained: Rows are waiting and the outbox has never been drained.
reasons.jobs_drain_stale: Rows are waiting and the last successful drain is older than {minutes} minutes.
reasons.jobs_dead_letters: Some rows failed every attempt and need attention.
reasons.jobs_no_drain_yet: No drain has run yet. Nothing is waiting.
